SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meetings m JOIN users u ON u.user_id = m.host_user_id
WHERE m.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')

SELECT m.meeting_id AS meetingId, m.host_user_id AS hostUserId, u.nickname AS hostNickname, m.title, m.status, m.invite_code AS inviteCode, m.desired_end_at AS desiredEndAt, COUNT(mp.participant_id) AS participantCount, m.final_candidate_id AS finalCandidateId, fc.place_name AS finalPlaceName, fc.address AS finalAddress, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM meetings m JOIN users u ON u.user_id = m.host_user_id LEFT JOIN meeting_participants mp ON mp.meeting_id = m.meeting_id LEFT JOIN meeting_candidates fc ON fc.candidate_id = m.final_candidate_id AND fc.meeting_id = m.meeting_id WHERE m.meeting_id = #{meetingId} GROUP BY m.meeting_id, m.host_user_id, u.nickname, m.title, m.status, m.invite_code, m.desired_end_at, m.final_candidate_id, fc.place_name, fc.address, m.created_at, m.updated_at

SELECT mp.participant_id AS participantId, mp.user_id AS userId, u.nickname, mp.input_status AS inputStatus, mp.departure_name AS departureName, mp.departure_address AS departureAddress, mp.return_name AS returnName, mp.return_address AS returnAddress, mp.submitted_at AS submittedAt, mp.created_at AS createdAt FROM meeting_participants mp JOIN users u ON u.user_id = mp.user_id WHERE mp.meeting_id = #{meetingId} ORDER BY mp.participant_id

SELECT mc.candidate_id AS candidateId, mc.place_name AS placeName, mc.address, mc.is_active AS active, u.user_id AS proposerUserId, u.nickname AS proposerNickname, COUNT(pv.vote_id) AS voteCount FROM meeting_candidates mc JOIN meeting_participants mp ON mp.participant_id = mc.proposer_participant_id AND mp.meeting_id = mc.meeting_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = mp.user_id LEFT JOIN place_votes pv ON pv.candidate_id = mc.candidate_id AND pv.meeting_id = mc.meeting_id AND pv.vote_type = 'CANDIDATE' WHERE mc.meeting_id = #{meetingId} GROUP BY mc.candidate_id, mc.place_name, mc.address, mc.is_active, u.user_id, u.nickname ORDER BY voteCount DESC, mc.candidate_id

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meeting_participants WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId}) AS totalParticipants, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_votes WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId}) AS votedParticipants, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_votes WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND vote_type = 'ABSTAIN') AS abstainCount

SELECT mc.candidate_id AS candidateId, mc.place_name AS placeName, COUNT(pv.vote_id) AS voteCount FROM meeting_candidates mc LEFT JOIN place_votes pv ON pv.candidate_id = mc.candidate_id AND pv.meeting_id = mc.meeting_id AND pv.vote_type = 'CANDIDATE' WHERE mc.meeting_id = #{meetingId} GROUP BY mc.candidate_id, mc.place_name ORDER BY voteCount DESC, mc.candidate_id

SELECT cm.message_id AS messageId, cm.meeting_id AS meetingId, cm.participant_id AS participantId, u.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(u.nickname, 'SYSTEM') AS nickname, cm.message_type AS messageType, cm.event_type AS eventType, cm.content, cm.created_at AS createdAt FROM chat_messages cm LEFT JOIN meeting_participants mp ON mp.participant_id = cm.participant_id AND mp.meeting_id = cm.meeting_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = mp.user_id WHERE cm.meeting_id = #{meetingId} ORDER BY cm.message_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
